verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Cloudflare edge SDK and states it ships 4 edge SDKs among its 30, so flags can be evaluated in CDN workers. It also documents a self-hosted Go Relay Proxy as an edge/relay layer, and a community report confirms the open-source Relay can be run in your own environment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of edge-worker evaluation, and detail beyond doc titles on which CDN platforms besides Cloudflare are supported and how evaluation and latency behave at the edge.
